seo.title: Villa OLIVA in Corfu — Private Pool Villa for 4 Guests | Aeolina Villas
seo.description: Villa OLIVA is a private pool villa in Episkopiana, Corfu with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, garden and mountain views, and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for families or couples.

hero.title: Villa OLIVA
hero.intro: Villa OLIVA is a 150 m² two-bedroom villa designed for comfort and peace. With a private pool, open terrace, and full kitchen, it’s the perfect choice for couples or families seeking a private escape in the Corfu countryside.
